limitations: Static independent source review establishes no fresh Terminal Bench reward or token saving.
nonblocking_observations: The legacy direct run API retains its inherited lack of a general purpose whitelist. New ordinary mode requires exact coding purpose; the CLI itself restricts purpose to coding/planning. Preserving legacy does not require changing this unrelated existing behavior.

This review read the authored test source, including both transports, reserved binding negatives, schema-custody negatives and actual fake CLI custody. It did not execute tests or inspect benchmark bodies.
reviewed_properties: Legacy default emits no contract suffix, coding receipt or coding output schema; native input, public/residual context and planning branches remain unchanged.
Owner-selected ordinary mode appends one fixed suffix after complete existing task/public/workspace presentation and attests both before/after model prompt hashes and bytes.

The same canonical closed 215-byte schema mapping reaches the private Codex adapter; unchanged adapter writes mode0600 schema, records digest and size and removes temporary files. Final acceptance independently requires observed digest/size equality.
Only ordinary coding via Codex may select the new mode; unknown modes and ordinary planning/non-Codex choices refuse before dispatch.

When semantic encoding is active, the unchanged strict native decoder runs before coding schema custody and acknowledgment validation. Foreign/missing/extra reserved bindings, stale producers, unknown aliases and native grammar failures cannot be relabeled as acknowledgment.

Acknowledgment validation requires a bounded 1024-byte exact two-field object with literal singleton values; duplicate keys, nonfinite constants, extra fields and malformed values fail without repair. Valid original text is returned unchanged.
Acknowledgment validation grants no execution, task completion, settlement or automatic retry authority; native candidate and owner admission remain external mandatory gates.
Both new failure phases and the coding contract file are already in the closed runner vocabulary; bridge child diagnostic validation imports that vocabulary through the existing runner parser.
